why: Hysteria 2 with salamander and a packet size (gecko in Xray).

singbox.why: Remnawave's sing-box generator (singbox.generator.service.ts) writes salamander without its packet size, which Xray reads as gecko (infra/conf Salamander.Build): the server of the sing-box JSON is plain salamander and does not talk to a gecko server. The link's fm and the Xray JSON make gecko.
